title: Senior Learning & Development Partner (f/m/d)
description:
Shape how a fast-growing company of 900 people learns.

What you'll do
- Run learning needs analyses with department heads and translate them into programmes
- Design onboarding and leadership journeys, including e-learning in Articulate
- Facilitate workshops and coach internal trainers
- Evaluate programmes and present impact data to the people leadership team

What you bring
- 5+ years in L&D or instructional design
- LMS administration and authoring-tool skills
- Evaluation experience (Kirkpatrick or similar)
- Excellent English; the company language is English
